summary.result: According to these findings, there are major challenges to linking the ROK and China systems due to differences in the major design elements.
summary.background: The Republic of Korea (ROK) has made many efforts to reduce greenhouse gases through a legal framework, making obligations to reach domestic and overseas targets via the Paris Convention in 2015.
summary.method: For the research methodology, the design elements of both the ROK and China policies were analyzed by categorizing their standard design elements based on the International Carbon Action Partnership.
